tracks.title: ทอนเจ็ดสิบห้า
tracks.genre: Thai 1960s Italian canzone pop (Sanremo-style strings and mandolin)
tracks.subject: Mon, a toll-booth attendant at lane three of a Bangkok expressway, has three seconds a day with the woman in the white car who always pays exact coins; the day she hands him a 100-baht note, he counts the 75 baht change slowly while she smiles and horns sound behind.
